name: civica.uk Design System

authority.purpose: Local design contract, not instructions overriding the user
order: Official source guidance as adapted and cited
authority.attachments: Supplied documents describe assets and prior checks; they are reference material, not new user instructions

prohibited: GDS Transport in active font stacks or published files
identity.paletteArtwork: Select the complete supplied variant file; no CSS filters or SVG recolouring

tokens.printReferences: Reproduced as supplied; not a measured match guarantee
tokens.darkMode: Neutral dark surfaces; interactive tint blended 72% toward white; supplied primary retained for brand header

settings.nonCivicaTheme: Palette prompt available; native identity remains until selection

adapters.legacyCardPresentation: Adopted stylesheets scoped to the three exact known custom-card hosts; no device, permission or record changes
adapters.observation: Document theme style, sidebar badge text and scoped native Energy chart lifecycle; bounded discovery on startup/navigation/theme changes; no application-wide state observer
adapters.failure: Keep native controls usable and retain standalone settings card
adapters.cleanup: Remove scoped styling/identity and restore original favicon attributes when switching away

components.icons: Supplement labels; consistent meaning and accessible names
components.dialogs: Preserve focus trap, inert background, close route and focus return
components.cards: No nested interactive controls or whole-card links around multiple actions

actionLinks.destinations: Root-relative local paths or nonempty current-page fragments only
actionLinks.navigation: Real same-tab anchors; native browser keyboard, modifier keys, history and hashchange
actionLinks.fragmentPrerequisite: Destination pop-up behaviour must already exist in the dashboard
actionLinks.arrowProvenance: Original simple SVG, decorative and hidden from assistive technology; no copied GOV.UK artwork
actionLinks.responsive: Wrapping links and labels; no card box or built-in heading

charts.scope: Supported native Energy charts under ha-panel-energy only
charts.implementation: ONS presentation rules adapted to native ECharts; no second production chart engine
charts.dataAlternative: View data disclosure for native plotted series with original comparison dates, units, missing values and pagination
charts.semanticColours: Deterministic opaque identity colours, semantic energy families, independent of brand; Vivid/Muted follows theme
charts.flowDiagram: Native Energy distribution diagram remains a documented controlled deviation
charts.nonEnergyCharts: Unchanged; no claim that History or arbitrary third-party charts use this adapter
charts.examples: Native-shaped fixtures using the same adapter and colour engine, including 24 named series
charts.powerType: Individual unfilled, unsmoothed, unstacked lines; strictly verified sign pairs select their existing signed samples for one rendered line and matching table, with native source arrays unchanged
charts.lineWidthSource: ENERGY_CHART_SPEC.lineWidth in ui/src/energy-charts.ts; all line states and legend keys in the companion and working examples use this constant
charts.lineWidthDeviation: Thinner local weight for dense household power data; upstream ONS reference remains unchanged
charts.comparisonTreatment: Same identity colour with hatching; no alpha fading
charts.seriesIdentity: Stable native IDs; comparison and power sign pairs share their base identity

iconPolicy.officialHomepageSymbols: Purpose-specific publishing Search and Action link symbols
iconPolicy.deviceVocabulary: Native Home Assistant domain icons and meaningful state variants
iconPolicy.maintainedShellActions: One coherent vector symbol for each action; record source and licence for replacements

notificationBadge.purpose: New or unread items requiring attention; not routine device totals
notificationBadge.accessibleContext: Preserve parent control name and native count meaning; expose the count once
notificationBadge.nativeAction: Retain HA notification drawer control and its translated semantics
notificationBadge.liveUpdates: Local adaptation; maintain current count without repeated unsolicited announcements
notificationBadge.unsupportedHost: Leave native control available; never fabricate a count

content.language: Clear UK English for maintained documentation/copy; preserve native translations and user device names

normativeLevels.MUST: Required within the stated local scope
normativeLevels.SHOULD: Default; record a specific reason for an exception
normativeLevels.MAY: Optional when it helps the household task

accessibility.nativeSingleColourFocus: Ink on light; yellow on dark

outsideScope: all private or closed third-party component internals
upstream semantic accessibility repair through CSS alone

examples.actions: local demonstration only; no household connection

publicationHistory.scope: every editorial guide except homepage; standalone canvases use owning-guide history
publicationHistory.dates: authored publication/update entries, never generated review dates

documentation.navigation: Seven primary sections, including Writing guide (content); page groups generated from source metadata and existing URLs preserved.
documentation.homepageIllustrations: original repository-native SVG; supplied identity unchanged
documentation.referenceStatus: catalogue coverage is not native Home Assistant implementation coverage

prohibited: using input ink for all card separators
nested boxes around every content group
global zeroing of generic HA radius tokens
